entries.text:
模仿姜月初也来做执棋境AI特效🥳

提示词如下：

【视觉风格】
3D国风玄幻电影质感，UE5级超精细渲染，冷黑与银白主色调，强烈明暗反差，肃杀、空灵、宏大而神秘。超真实材质、体积光、粒子与物理破碎效果，强调天地尺度变化与电影级镜头运动。画面纯净，无字幕、无文字、无现实人物肖像，不借用任何现有国漫 IP。主角参考图1。
【镜头节奏】
0-2秒 | 局中人
镜头从一方古朴玉石棋盘极近距离掠过，黑白棋子错落铺陈，玉石纹理与细微冷光清晰可见。焦点由棋盘迅速转移至女子侧颜，她安静坐在棋局前，纤指夹住一枚黑棋悬停半空。长发垂落，玉簪映出微弱银光，目光始终落在棋盘上，周围环境仿佛陷入寂静。
2-4秒 | 一子惊局
镜头压低并环绕手部，黑棋在指间缓慢翻转，冷光随着棋子移动掠过棋盘。女子忽然抬眼，原本平静的目光变得深邃凌厉。棋子落下的一刻，棋盘内部浮现出细密银色光纹，并迅速向四周扩散，脚下地面出现第一道裂痕。
4-8秒 | 山河入局
棋子触碰棋盘的瞬间，银白能量从落点爆发，形成低空横扫的环形震荡。镜头贴近地面高速后撤，冲击波所经之处，大地如被无形巨刃切割，山脉、河流与岩层逐层断裂，巨大的地形模块从地表升起并重新排列。
白裙与长发被狂暴气流卷翘，但女子始终端坐原地纹丝不动，形成强烈的动静反差。碎石、尘雾、冷光粒子在空中交织，地貌逐渐显现出棋盘般的秩序。
8-10秒 | 天地成局
镜头急速升空，由中景拉至极高空俯视。原本完整的山河已经化作纵横交错的巨大棋局，群山成为棋子般的巨大方块，河流化作银色棋路，断裂地貌悬浮于深邃天地之间。
镜头继续后拉，女子成为棋局中心极小却醒目的存在。幽暗天地与银白棋路形成巨大视觉反差，云层、尘埃和粒子围绕棋局缓慢旋转，呈现“以天地为盘、山河为子”的宏大格局。
【结尾余韵】
能量逐渐平息，悬浮山河缓慢归位，棋盘纹路上的银白光线依次熄灭，只留下女子独坐中央。镜头保持高空俯视并缓慢下降，最终定格在她与完整天地棋局的全景图上，气氛寂静、冷峻、威严，传达一种不动而掌控山河的压迫感。
【视觉强化】
高精度衣物与发丝动力学，真实玉石与岩石材质；碎裂、悬浮、重组具有明确物理运动轨迹；体积雾、尘埃、冷白能量粒子、地表裂纹和光线衰减自然融合。避免廉价游戏 CG 感、过度 HDR、塑料材质与无规律特效堆叠。镜头运动具有电影摄影逻辑，动态模糊适度，重点突出“静止人物 × 极速天地变化”的反差。

entries.text: Seedance 2.0 on Higgsfield AI  One of my favorite action sequences from the open-sourced Higgsfield Originals.  Full open-sourced prompts & assets below:  STYLE: cinematic theatrical action-anime, movie-grade "Jujutsu Kaisen 0" / Ufotable register — painterly hand-drawn characters over gritty cinematic 3D-CG depth, dramatic radial light-streamers and energy lines, heavy bloom, chromatic aberration, anamorphic flares, gritty grain and texture, blood-spatter realism. Native 4K ultra-high detail encoded at a high bitrate of 80–120 Mbps for maximum image fidelity: every spark, energy line, blood droplet, water droplet, ember and debris shard rendered sharp and individually readable; rich painterly texture.  FACE & ACTING QUALITY: premium movie-grade character animation — highly detailed faces with skin texture, sweat, blood smears, flushed strain, fine hair strands and sharp catch-lights in the glowing eyes; vivid, raw, emotional expressions — gritted bloodied teeth, blazing wide eyes, savage fury, desperate effort and agonized pain; expressive frame-by-frame facial acting.  LIGHTING: night riverbank, cold moonlight key with a dark cloudy sky; intense blue energy glow on the hero and red energy glow on the rival as the two violent accents, both reflecting and shimmering on the river surface; a blinding white core flash at the point of impact; hard rim separating both fighters from the dark water and debris; thousands of glowing streaks, particles, water droplets and embers refracting light.  COLOR: deep moonlit blue-black on the left, blood-crimson on the right, a white impact core at center, the dark river mirroring the energies; the two fighters the saturated subjects; high contrast, gritty, no flat color. CAMERA: anamorphic cine optics, real motion blur, register shifts, strong dynamic foreshortening — explosive crash on the entrance and collision, fast dynamic tracking through the blow exchange, extreme slow macro on the sparks and water particles, a fast whip-spin into the tornado super strike, a tight close-up on the rival's scream, then a rising wide as the body is launched and disintegrates in mid-air; radial speed-streamers and energy lines ripping from the impact center.  MATERIAL: a colossal blue energy dragon arm/claw with scaled translucent light and flexing draconic talons, a huge crimson arc-shaped greatsword engraved with molten runes, energy streamers, tattered fabric and torn cloaks, dark articulated outfits, blood droplets and smears, wet rocky riverbank, dark flowing river water, splashes and spray, suspended jagged rubble,  crystalline energy fragments, fine dust and countless embers.  PARTICLE DETAIL: dense, finely-detailed particle work — radial energy streaks, sparks, blood droplets, water droplets and spray, crystalline shards, rock grit, dust and embers fill the air in layered depth; sparks, mist and small particles drift and streak in slow motion, each catching light; the air shimmers and distorts around the energies.  PHYSICS: true force and momentum — the dragon claw and the curved greatsword meet with a radial shockwave that quakes and cracks the ground outward and visibly ripples, waves and splashes the river; rubble, blood, water and energy shards blast away in slow arcs and fall under gravity; every heavy strike shakes the earth and disturbs the water with concentric ripples, surges and spray; cloaks and hair whip in the blast wind; the river flows and churns, reacting to the action in frame; energy streamers snap and trail with motion.  COMPOSITION: spectacular dynamic-angle wide on the dragon-arm-vs-greatsword clash split blue-vs-red on the riverbank, fast tracking through a dynamic blow exchange, extreme macro on the core and flying particles, a spinning low-angle on the hero's tornado super strike, a tight close-up on the rival's agonized scream, then a rising wide on the rival's body launched and disintegrating in mid-air; depth from foreground rubble, water and sparks to the fighters to the dark night sky; explosive kinetic scale.  CHARACTER DESIGN (original, not based on any franchise): - BLUE HERO: a young male fighter with spiky dark hair with crimson-red tips, glowing blue eyes, a torn dark outfit and trailing cape, blood-smeared muscled body; his right arm is transformed into a massive blue energy dragon arm — a scaled draconic limb ending in clawed talons, wreathed in surging blue energy and a water/lightning streamer. Fierce, savage, heroic.  - RED RIVAL: a male fighter with dark wind-blown hair, a torn crimson cloak, wreathed in violent red energy; he wields a huge curved arc-shaped greatsword glowing crimson with molten runes along the blade. Battered, snarling, ferocious.  CONTINUITY: same blue hero with the dragon arm, same red rival with the curved greatsword, same energies, same night riverbank and river across all cuts. AUDIO: diegetic only — flowing river water, howling wind and low rumble, two roaring battle shouts, a ground-quaking detonation and water splash on the clash, ringing sword and roaring dragon-claw swings, snapping energy streamers, a rising charge and tornado howl on the super strike, a colossal final impact, the rival's agonized scream of pain, a soft dissolving shimmer as he turns to dust in the air, settling water and ringing silence under a subsonic boom.  SCENE CONTEXT At night on a rocky riverbank, a blue hero with a dragon-arm and a crimson rival with a huge curved greatsword charge in and collide head-on in an earth-shaking, water-rippling detonation; after a brutal dynamic exchange the hero spins up into a tornado and unleashes a super strike that launches the screaming rival into the air, where his body freezes in slow motion and disintegrates into particles in mid-air without ever falling.  LOCATION MAP Foreground: wet shattered rocky riverbank, suspended rubble, dust and energy shards, the edge of a dark flowing river. Midground: the two fighters, blue hero screen-left, red rival screen-right. Background: the river running through the scene, dark wooded banks, a cloudy moonlit night sky. The white impact core sits dead center between them; the river mirrors the blue and red glow.  FIRST FRAME / BLOCKING Low dynamic foreshortened angle on the night riverbank, the blue hero lunging from screen-left driving his glowing blue dragon-arm claw toward center, blood-smeared and screaming, glowing blue eyes; the red rival at screen-right swinging his huge curved crimson greatsword to meet it, wreathed in red energy, snarling; claw and blade meet at center in a blinding white core bursting radial blue-and-red streamers across the whole frame; wet rocks and the dark river below, moonlight above, debris, blood and water droplets suspended, blue/red split light reflecting on the water.  FORMAT MODE Controlled multi-shot sequence, ~15 seconds total, with HARD CUTS at 3.0s, 6.0s, 9.0s, 11.0s and 13.0s. Mixed real-time and slow motion. The camera does not cut on its own.  OPTICS SEGMENT 1 (0.0–3.0s) — WS 63° dynamic wide entrance and clash on the riverbank. SEGMENT 2 (3.0–6.0s) — MS 47° fast tracking through a dynamic blow exchange. SEGMENT 3 (6.0–9.0s) — ECU 18° extreme macro on the core, sparks and water particles.  SEGMENT 4 (9.0–11.0s) — WS 63° low-angle on the hero's tornado spin-up. SEGMENT 5 (11.0–13.0s) — CU 29° tight on the rival's agonized scream as the strike launches him.  SEGMENT 6 (13.0–15.0s) — WS 63° rising wide on the airborne body disintegrating in mid-air. No drift mid-segment.  CAMERA A spectacular crash-wide on the entrance and collision, a fast dynamic tracking camera weaving through the blow exchange, an extreme slow macro pushing into the core and particles, a whip-spin orbiting the hero's tornado, a tight push on the rival's screaming face as he is launched, then a rising wide craning up with the airborne body as it dissolves to dust.  ACTION 0.0s–3.0s (real time, explosive): on the night riverbank the blue hero and red rival burst in from opposite sides — cloaks snapping, blue and crimson energy flaring — and collide head-on, dragon-claw against curved greatsword, detonating a blinding white core that quakes and cracks the ground and blasts the river into rippling waves and spray, debris and radial streamers flying outward, both screaming.  3.0s HARD CUT. 3.0s–6.0s (real time, fast and dynamic): a furious moving blow exchange — the hero slashes and snaps with his blue dragon-arm claw, the rival parries and swings the huge curved greatsword in heavy arcs; they dash, pivot and trade strikes across the riverbank, sparks and clashing energy bursting on each contact, rocks shattering, water kicked up in spraying sheets, dust and embers streaking past, the camera tracking fast through the motion — alive and kinetic, never static.  6.0s HARD CUT. 6.0s–9.0s (extreme slow motion): macro on the white-hot impact core where claw meets blade; in dense detail a shockwave-driven wind of energy, blood droplets, water spray and sparks burst outward and spiral toward the lens, each particle sharp and glowing, the air vibrating and rippling.  9.0s HARD CUT. 9.0s–11.0s (real time into slow motion): the hero breaks away, eyes blazing, plants low and begins to spin — his blue dragon-arm and energy whipping into a rotating vortex that builds into a towering blue tornado around him, dragging in dust, water-mist, rocks and sparks, the river surging and spiraling toward him, the rival's battered eyes going wide.  11.0s HARD CUT. 11.0s–13.0s (slow motion): out of the spinning tornado the hero unleashes the finishing super strike — the dragon-arm claw erupts forward in a spiraling blue blast that slams into the rival and launches his body up off the ground into the air with a blinding flash and a burst of water and debris. Tight close-up on the rival's face contorting in an agonized scream of pain as he is thrown upward, blood and energy tearing across his features.  13.0s HARD CUT. 13.0s–15.0s (extreme slow motion): rising wide — the rival's airborne body reaches the top of its arc and freezes, suspended in mid-air above the riverbank; for a beat it hangs motionless, then is torn apart atom by atom, fracturing into countless glowing particles and crystalline motes that scatter and drift outward in the air. The body never falls — it disperses entirely into a slowly drifting cloud of dust suspended over the dark river. Below, the blue hero lands from the spin, energy fading, the water settling. Hold on the drifting dust in the air. Hard cut to black.  PHYSICS The entrance collision quakes and cracks the ground and blasts the river into ripples, waves and spray; the dynamic blow exchange shatters rocks and kicks up sheets of water with every strike; every heavy impact shakes the earth and disturbs the water with concentric ripples and surges; rubble, blood, water and energy shards blast away in slow arcs and fall under gravity; cloaks and hair whip in the blast wind; the tornado spin builds real rotational momentum, dragging dust, mist, rocks and water into a vortex; the final super strike sends the rival's body airborne with real launch force, then it disintegrates at the apex into particles that drift and disperse in the air without falling, scattering as suspended dust over the river.  LIGHTING Night riverbank, cold moonlight key, dark cloudy sky; intense blue and red energy glow rim-lighting both fighters and reflecting on the river; a blinding white core flash at impact; a bright blue surge swirling through the tornado on the super strike; the rival's dissolving particles glow softly as they scatter in the air. Embers and motes refracting. No flat light, no clean color.  POSITIVE LOCKS Same blue hero with a blue energy dragon arm/claw and same red rival with a huge curved crimson greatsword in every cut, both original designs, fighting at night on a rocky riverbank beside a flowing river. Spectacular entrance and earth-shaking, water-rippling head-on collision split blue-vs-red; a fast dynamic moving blow exch

entries.text: 15秒电影级CGI，4K 60FPS，超高清，超写实东方古城雨夜武侠美学。 严格参考上传图片的整体画面风格、构图气质、光效、阴影、材质反射、色调与战斗氛围。 场景设定为暴雨中的古代东方城楼屋顶，黑色湿瓦延伸向远方，四周是层层叠叠的古建筑、灯火通明的楼阁、飞檐、木质结构与被雨幕笼罩的夜城。远处暖黄色灯笼光与近处冷蓝月光交织，屋顶积水、雨水飞溅、空气雾气、反光瓦面与高速动作形成强烈电影张力。 画面中是两名高强度对决的东方武侠角色： 左侧角色为一名身披暗红长袍、长发飞扬的剑客，动作敏捷凌厉，衣摆与长发在高速运动中甩出巨大弧线，气质冷峻、狠厉、进攻性极强。 右侧角色为一名身穿黑蓝色战斗服、披带毛领、面部遮挡的冷静剑士，动作更稳、更克制、更偏防反与借力化劲，气质沉着、锋利、危险。 两人都使用修长长刀 / 唐刀式长刃武器展开高速近身武器对决。 整体战斗风格强调：借力打力、卸力挪移、贴身化劲、顺势反制、四两拨千斤，不是简单蛮力对砍，而是具有高级武学逻辑的攻防博弈。 所有视觉重点集中在：兵器碰撞、雨水炸裂、水雾、残影拖尾、粒子爆发、能量冲击、衣袍运动、力量传递和高速摄影冲击感。 开场（0s–3s） 穿越机镜头以低空贴瓦高速掠行开场，沿着湿滑发亮的黑瓦屋顶冲入战场，镜头带有强烈速度感与微微失重感，雨丝迎面压来，地面积水被镜头气流切开。 两名剑士已经处于高速交战状态，镜头掠入瞬间，左侧红袍剑客与右侧黑蓝剑士正面高速接近，刀锋在画面中央猛烈碰撞。 第一次交击瞬间炸开巨大的环形冲击波，同时爆发大量雨水飞溅、银白火星、冷白碎光、细碎水雾、半透明冲击纹与高密度粒子喷发。 穿越机镜头快速绕两人做急速盘旋，形成强烈的动态包围感。 左侧红袍剑客脚下猛蹬瓦面，瓦面瞬间炸开一圈积水波纹与碎裂水珠，整个人借反作用力高速横移，拖出数道淡淡残影、衣摆拖尾与水珠粒子尾迹。 右侧黑蓝剑士连续挥刀压进，斜斩、横斩、直刺接连逼迫而来，刀势凌厉、节奏极快；左侧剑客不正面死拼，而是以手腕、肩背、腰胯、步法不断卸力、引偏、滑开，每次接触都将对方的力量顺势化掉。 刀刃擦过时持续爆出火花、碎雨、水雾与银白粒子，形成层层叠加的视觉爆点。 中段（4s–9s） 战斗节奏全面升级。 穿越机镜头时而贴地仰拍，时而突然拔高后俯冲，时而越过角色肩头贴身穿行，时而从两把长刀之间险险穿过，始终以高速环绕、压迫式贴身运镜捕捉这场刀战。 右侧黑蓝剑士突然发力，一记重斩猛然压下，左侧红袍剑客单手举刀格挡，刀刃交击点瞬间炸开高密度粒子风暴：雨水被震成白雾，银白火星、冷光碎屑、冲击波纹、水滴爆裂与空气震荡同时向四周扩散。 受反震影响，左侧角色的红袍、长发、围巾、衣摆沿动作切线大幅甩动，在雨夜中拉出极具张力的弧线残影。 左侧红袍剑客借对方压下来的刀势旋身卸劲，身体低伏滑步，整个人像贴着瓦面流动一般滑出，刀锋沿空气划出一道长长的冷白刀光轨迹与半透明雨水弧痕。 下一瞬她借力反弹切回内线，贴身逼近，连续完成： 拨刀、转腕、压刃、滑步切入、回身斩、低位横切、腾身翻转反压，动作一气呵成，丝滑连贯，绝无跳帧。 右侧黑蓝剑士则以更加稳健的重心与精密的身体控制进行应对，用极小幅度的刀路、手臂调整、腰部旋转与步伐腾挪化解对方攻势，体现“以静制动、以后发先至”的高级武学气质。 快镜头强化兵器高速连击的凌厉感，慢镜头则短暂定格关键瞬间： 刀锋咬合、力量从手臂传导到刀柄、再压进对方兵器与身体重心，所有力量变化通过雨水喷流方向、残影轨迹、衣袍运动与粒子流向被可视化表现出来。 后段高潮（10s–15s） 进入高潮阶段，右侧黑蓝剑士双手握刀蓄力，重心猛然下沉，随后爆发一记极强的高速贯穿式突进斩。 刀锋前方撕开雨幕，形成明显的雨水分流、空气压缩痕迹与长条状粒子风暴，整个人像一枚黑蓝色利矢般直刺而来。 镜头先迅速拉远，给出两人在屋顶中心对冲的完整全身轮廓，随后再以高速前冲猛然逼近。 左侧红袍剑客不退反进，迎着刀势冲上，以极小的动作精准贴住对方刀锋外侧，不硬拼，而是借刀势、顺刀路、化中心线，以手腕、肩背、腰胯与滑步共同引导对方攻击轨迹偏移。 此处慢镜头介入，清晰展现力量如何从右侧角色的刀身一路传导，再被左侧角色精准卸开，最终在空气中拉出一道巨大的弧形雨水轨迹、冷白冲击纹与半透明粒子旋带。 左侧红袍剑客顺势滑步绕入侧后方，借力旋身爆发连续反制： 一记上撩斩带起大量雨滴喷发、银白火星与冷色粒子； 一记横斩切出宽大的半月形刀光与水雾刀浪； 最后接一记高速旋身终结斩，整个人如红色旋风般卷起巨大的雨水漩涡、碎光粒子与残影风暴。 右侧黑蓝剑士被这一连串借力反制牵入冲击核心，身体在连续的力量传导、雨雾冲击、粒子风暴与刀势压迫中被强行带偏重心，整个人在视觉上像被卷入一圈剧烈扩散的环形能量场。 终极收尾时，左侧红袍剑客一刀定势斩出，刀锋前方瞬间爆发一道巨大的弧形斩击冲击波，伴随高密度雨水海啸、冷白碎光、银色火星、半透明气浪与飞散粒子向外炸开。 右侧黑蓝剑士被冲击掀退，身形失衡向后拉开。 左侧角色落地滑行收势，长刀斜垂，衣摆、长发、围巾与残影缓缓回落，身后仍残留延迟消散的雨丝轨迹、粒子尾流与力量余波。 镜头高速环绕至她的正前方，最终定格在一个极具压迫感和胜负余韵的英雄式收尾构图上。 entries.text: 使用参照: @image1  【基本仕様】 15秒、1:1スクエア。手描き作画を基調とした、高密度で華やかな劇場版2Dセルアニメーション。 @image1 から主役1人の顔、髪型、体格、頭身、衣装、装甲、背部リング、配色、SPECIAL MODE、舞台モチーフを継承する。白背景、枠線、文字、パネル構成、複数方向図、CG的陰影、写実的金属反射は動画へ出さない。 明確な輪郭線、整理されたセル影、鮮明な色面、強いパース、形を大胆に崩す作画で統一する。3D CG、ゲームムービー、2.5D CG、滑らかな3D補間、直立姿勢のまま滑る空中移動にはしない。 高速な機械アクションBGM＋効果音。台詞、歌声、字幕、タイトル文字なし。  【構造固定】 主役の背部リングは身体へ接続された個人装備。 機械馬は、暴走する回転木馬型メカ外周の巨大機械馬で、腹部に固定式の吊り金具を1つ持つ。 大型道化ドローンは、太い胴体と固定長の関節式アームを持つ一体の大型機。 最終装置は、長い直線アーム、巨大ハンマーヘッド、固定ハンドル、直線型制御レバーを持つ巨大振り子式メカアーム。 これらを融合・変形させない。  【動画の核】 暴走装置を、主役が足場、反動、方向転換装置として逆利用する高速アクション。 見せ場は、 1. 機械馬とのニアミスから遠心力射出 2. 大型道化ドローンとの空中カウンター 3. 巨大振り子へ飛び移り、制御レバーを両足で反転 の3つ。 各見せ場は、迫る脅威→短いタメ→明確な接触→主役と相手双方の大きな反応→反動を次の動作へ利用、でつなぐ。 接触直前だけ速度を急減してタメを作り、接触フレームで爆発的に加速。1〜2フレームの白黒インパクト、極端なスミア、速度線、色面反転、前景遮蔽を使う。接触後は主役の姿勢と、相手の向き・形・回転を大きく変える。 エフェクトは @image1 の主配色を基調とし、接触点と転換時だけ補色を強く使う。全編を同じ発光色で覆わない。  【時間構成】 0.0〜3.8秒｜機械馬 暴走する回転木馬型メカの巨大機械馬が背後から迫る。主役は床面を全力疾走し、低い路面追従で足元と蹄を同時に見せる。 蹄が直前へ落ちる瞬間、身体を深く沈めて横向きに高速スライディング。白黒のニアミスインパクト。 腹部を抜ける瞬間に吊り金具を片手で掴み、遠心力で身体を水平近くまで振り回される。遠心力が最大になる瞬間に手を離し、会場奥上空へ射出。回転木馬も反動で逆方向へ大きく回る。  3.8〜7.3秒｜大型道化ドローン 大型ドローンが正面から突進。主役は空中で膝を引き寄せてタメを作り、正面装甲を片足で強く蹴る。足裏と装甲の接触、星形インパクト、装甲のへこみを明確に見せる。 ドローンは横へ傾いて急回転し、主役も逆方向へ回転。回転中に固定長アームを片手で掴み、推進力で振り回され、円弧の頂点で手を離して巨大振り子へ飛ぶ。アームを触手やケーブルへ変えない。 7.3〜10.8秒｜振り子と空中SPECIAL MODE 主役は振り子アーム側面の固定ハンドルを両手で掴み、観客席へ迫るハンマーヘッドと共に大きく振られる。 身体を小さく畳んだままSPECIAL MODEへ移行。黒いシルエット→白い反転→背部リング展開→結晶ブレードと推進光点火。 停止・着地・正面変身は禁止。推進力で固定ハンドルから身体を引き上げ、アーム基部側の踏み切り位置へ一気に移る。 10.8〜12.8秒｜制御レバーへ両足衝突 振り子が最高点へ達した瞬間、踏み切り位置から離れて空中反転。背部リングの推進で両足を前へ向け、長く太い制御レバーへ直接突入する。 身体を丸めてタメ→両脚を伸ばす→両足とレバーが接触→白黒インパクト→レバーが反対側へ大きく倒れる。 主役は反動で中央上空へ弾かれ、ハンマーヘッドは観客席直前で停止して会場奥側へ振り戻される。 12.8〜15.0秒｜超広角クライマックス レバー反転の白い衝撃面から、会場外周まで見える高い斜め俯瞰へ瞬間転換。ゆっくりしたプルバックは禁止。 画面内で確認できる機械レールと歯車列に沿って発光パルスが走る。 巨大歯車が反転 →ハンマーヘッドが安全方向へ振り戻る →歯車アーチ、多層リング、回転木馬が一つの波として同期回転 →観客席へ光の波が広がり、レール終端から機械花火が一斉点火。 主役は中央上空に人型の全身シルエットとして残し、光線や流星へ変えない。姿勢を立て直しながら背部リングを回転させる。 最後の身体動作、レバー反転、機械連鎖、花火点火の因果が一目で読める瞬間で終了する。 【禁止事項】 アイドル的ダンス、移動だけのモンタージュ、接触の見えない攻撃、伸縮する触手状アーム、主役リングと会場装置の融合、静止SPECIAL MODE、光線による遠隔操作、単色で安価なゲームエフェクト、意味不明な光跡ラスト、人物の決めポーズだけのラスト、狭い最終画角、文字、ロゴ、透かし。

entries.text: It's easy to do with copy-paste! Battle action set in an Asian market  Lately, I've been studying cool action scenes, but I ended up watching Mamoru Oshii's *Ghost in the Shell* really closely, so my head is still stuck on Ghost in the Shell imagery and I can't shake it off...  That's why it ended up feeling pretty influenced, but it turned out pretty good.  Basically, if you reference two images of the characters you want to fight, they'll battle it out in an Asian market.  I hadn't really made much action before, but trying to create cool action is seriously tough.  I think I generated this about 30 times... (Various action attempts)  ------------ Prompt ------------ High-density action in a theatrical anime style. Color tone: Cool teal-tinged color grading as the base. Keep saturation and brightness subdued overall, avoiding pure colors. Don't crush dark areas to black; sink them into teal-tinged grays. Only the amber-colored exposed bulbs at the stalls and the sparks scattering in moments of destruction have saturation. Overcast diffused light, damp air feel. No BGM, no dialogue, ambient sounds present. Field of view like a full-frame 24mm F1.4 wide-angle lens.  # Constraints Vary the framing, angle, focal length, and camera height in every shot to avoid monotony. Add rhythm to shot lengths with fast and slow pacing. Shots marked "momentary insert" should be extremely short. Do not display text, subtitles, or logos on screen. The road surface is wet and reflective. Do not use fade-outs. The footage always fully fills the screen to all four corners, without circular black frames or dark vignettes. The shopkeepers are always in the shadows away from the fight, never getting involved in the combat.  # Direction Notes (Most Important - Common to All Shots) Left-right positioning: Character A on screen left, Character B on screen right. Facing: Character A always facing right. Character B always facing left. The camera always shoots from the same side of the line connecting the two, absolutely maintaining this left-right relationship in every shot. Do not swap left and right in any shot.  # Characters ## Character A  @Image1  ## Character B  @Image2  ## Shopkeepers 2-3 elderly market shopkeepers. Wearing aprons. Staying in the shadows away from the fight.  # Setting Narrow alley in an old Asian downtown market. Near closing time, no customers around. Various shops densely packed on both sides: A general store piled with plastic buckets, pots, and brooms, A butcher shop with dried meats and sausages hanging, A small diner with steaming soup stockpots lined up, A greengrocer with fruits and vegetables piled high, a fishmonger with foam boxes packed with ice. Waterproof sheet awnings covering overhead. Lighting: Amber glow from exposed bulbs hanging above. Wet road surface reflecting that light. Depth composition: Foreground with hanging dried meats and sundries, midground with the two fighters, background with the market alley stretching into the distance.  # Scene Character B walks up close to Character A standing in the near-closing market. As the shopkeepers hide in the shadows and watch, the two's fight progressively destroys various shops, Character A cuts off the flow with steam from the diner and takes it to the rooftops for a reversal.  cut1: 85mm telephoto compression. Character A's (facing right) shoulder and back of head large and blurred in the foreground occupying screen left, Over the shoulder, Character B (facing left) slowly approaches from the depths beyond the row of hanging dried meats at the butcher shop. At the alley's edge, one general store shopkeeper senses something and quietly crouches low behind the stall. Ambient sound: Only the sound of wet footsteps approaching.  cut2: Momentary insert. Macro. Character A's (facing right) eye area. Amber light grazes the pupil, which narrows sharply.  cut3: Momentary insert. Macro. Character A's shoe sole gripping the wet road surface, Crushing a piece of ice. Sound effect: Short crunch of ice breaking.  cut4: 16mm ultra-wide, ultra-low position skimming the ground. Character A (facing right, screen left to right) explodes forward in a straight dash down the alley. Wind pressure topples the general store's pile of plastic buckets and brooms, The shopkeeper calmly but swiftly ducks under the stall. Water splashes cross in front of the lens. Sound effect: Thunderous foot plant, buckets rolling.  cut5: Medium shot. Character A (screen left, facing right)'s initial strike Is parried by Character B (screen right, facing left) with one arm, Counterstrike slams Character A into the greengrocer's shelves. Shelves half-collapse, fruits tumble down, piled veggies spill and scatter across the road. Sound effect: Impact thud, shelves splintering, fruits rolling.  cut6: Momentary insert. From behind the stall, half a face peeking out—the greengrocer shopkeeper Staring blankly at his collapsing shelves. Ambient sound: Fruits continuing to fall.  cut7: Character A's POV. Incoming flurry from Character B (facing left) closing in. View shakes left and right, Through the gap in the defending arm, the opponent's cold eyes visible. Sound effect: Continuous impacts hitting the arm.  cut8: Momentary insert. Macro. In Character A's line of sight, Right next to them, the diner's kitchen with stockpots still steaming.  cut9: Character A (screen left, facing right) kicks over the diner's stockpot. White steam and soup splatter erupt explosively into the alley, Blinding Character B (screen right)'s view in white. The entire screen engulfed in steam. Sound effect: Metal crashing down, roaring steam.  cut10: Momentary insert. Dutch angle close-up. Through the steam, Flickering from a wildly swinging bulb illuminates Character B (facing left)'s face, The composure fades from the expression as they swipe at the steam with an arm. Character A is nowhere to be seen. Sound effect: Bulb cord creaking, steam hissing.  cut11: Low angle. Piercing through the steam ceiling, Character A (facing right) kicks off the butcher shop's awning support and leaps to the rooftop in silhouette. The row of hanging sausages swings wildly from the recoil. Sound effect: Kicking the support, hanging items swaying.  cut12: Low angle, from Character B (screen right, facing left)'s viewpoint side looking up. Character A atop the roof (screen upper left) becomes a backlit silhouette, Cutting through the overcast sky behind, lunging down from above. Sound effect: Kicking the sheet, wind whistling.  cut13: [Slow motion with stretched time] Character A (screen upper left) twisting body mid-fall, And Character B (screen lower right, facing left) looking up to counter. Between them, one swinging bulb tears free from its cord and floats in midair. The amber light slowly rotates. Camera slides diagonally between them. Sound effect: Low sustained rumble.  cut14: Time snaps back. Character A's strike, loaded with full falling weight, Slams Character B (screen right) into the road surface. The impact ripples outward in concentric circles, collapsing surrounding shops; sundries, fruits, and ice surge like waves, The severed bulb bounces on the road, scattering sparks. As the splashes settle, shopkeepers cautiously peek out from behind stalls, Surveying their shops now reduced to rubble. Only Character A (screen left, facing right) remains standing in the alley, in follow-through pose. Ambient sound: Thunderous landing, chain of collapses, then only dripping water.

entries.text: Prompt Released!!  It still has quite a bit of gacha elements left, but I made an improved version where the movement is super snappy and responsive!!  The high-speed 360-degree orbit is especially unstable, but the source material was just too cool, so I couldn't bear to remove it… (lol) Try playing around with the two original characters included!  Facial expression changes, camera work, and dynamic movements should all be way better now…!  【Prompt】 Concept: The camera never stops for even a moment. It's constantly moving in the fastest, smallest amplitude micro-movements, like another dancer. The basic rhythm is densely packed at 16th notes (dividing each beat into 4 or more), and with every subdivision, the camera must snap, tick, zoom in, or pull back. No static frames are created. Even in a pose's decisive moment, the camera keeps up high-frequency micro-vibrations while holding the composition, pulsing subtly even if it looks stopped. No drawn-out mid-speed pans at all. All movements are snappy motions with sharp start and end points, no slow interpolations in between. Throughout the entire piece, run constant micro-motions (fastest, small amplitude, high frequency): Micro-zoom bursts (in each subdivision, rapid back-and-forth zoom in/out by a few percent, endlessly pulsing) Beat bounce (camera subtly bounces up and down in sync with foot steps and knee dips) Jitter pan (small, choppy left-right ticks in time with shoulder hits and head shakes) Micro-shake (sharp pixel-level jolt on strong beats, immediately into the next subdivision) High-speed reframing (micro-adjust the composition every 16th note, constantly repositioning the two into the best spots) Micro-orbit reciprocation (small-angle left-right sway around the central axis) Instant sync per body part (sharp and fast): Shoulder hit → Camera snaps in the opposite direction Fingertips/arm lines → Zoom micro-tracks the trajectory at high speed Head shake/hair sway → Camera sharply swings in the same direction and snaps back Waist wave/body roll → Camera undulates vertically in tiny ripples Spot turn → Camera counter-rotates in small chops Big dramatic flourishes (deploy at max speed on decisive moments, but keep micro-vibrations going even after): Snap zoom (zoom in/out at max speed to instant arrival, continue micro-zoom afterward) Whip pan (whip at max speed between the two, transition to micro-vibration hold at the decisive head) Rapid crane dive/crane up High-speed 360-degree orbit Dolly zoom (background stretch/compress only, one shot) Floor-skimming low angle → sudden rise Dutch angle (bold tilt on decisive beats, keep micro-vibrating in the tilted state)  Rhythm Principles: Throughout: Camera never stops for a single frame, keeps subdividing at max speed and minimal amplitude. Strong beats: Layer big flourishes on top of micro-motions (don't stop the subdivisions). Decisive moments: Not complete stillness, but "micro-vibration hold." Composition fixed, camera keeps subtly alive. If the two turn, camera counter-rotates; jumps get a bounce and lift; forward steps get a snapped retreat—react to everything at max speed. No cuts; connect everything with live-show-style flowing switches.  【15-Second Structure】 ■0.0–2.0 sec From ultra-wide near the ceiling, on the first beat, trigger max-speed crane dive + snap zoom to drop into a two-shot bust-up. As they land, micro-zoom and beat bounce start pulsing, and from then on, it never stops for a moment. The two do simultaneous shoulder/neck/waist isolations; on each hit, camera snaps choppily in the opposite direction. Eye-contact smiles are held with micro-vibration for allure. ■2.0–4.0 sec Half-orbit the central axis at high speed while circling, rapid-fire micro-zooms every 16th note. Side-by-side left/right steps/hand heart/chest heart/pointing (mirror choreography); beat bounce up/down on every step. Even at the decisive head, no stopping—transition to micro-vibration hold, keeping the hair's afterimage in frame. ■4.0–6.0 sec Floor-skimming low-angle hype shot. Camera ripples vertically in tiny waves with body rolls/waist waves. Jitter pan left/right on every shoulder hit. Rapid crane up from the feet at max speed. Chin-up smiles held with micro-vibration + dutch angle (tilted, subtly shaking). ■6.0–8.0 sec Snap zoom to one, then whip pan to the other for back-and-forth interplay. Even zoomed in, micro-shake keeps sharp micro-vibrations going. Each does lip-sync, cheek peace/hand heart/head tilt. Zoom high-speed tracks fingertips. Decisive moments held with micro-vibration to showcase expressions. ■8.0–10.0 sec 360-degree high-speed orbit for a full circle, as the two do high-speed spot turns (left-right symmetric). Camera counter-rotates in small chops with the turns, and at the end, no stopping—into micro-orbit reciprocation. They align hand hearts into one big heart; even then, micro-zoom pulses at minimal amplitude. ■10.0–12.0 sec (Chorus) Max-speed punch-out to wide. Full-stage big duet dance. Diagonal moves → central gather; beat bounce syncs to every step. Simultaneous jump gets camera bounce and lift. Big unison arm lines, zoom tracks the trajectory. Chorus head gets one dolly zoom, micro-shake continues through the stretch/compress. ■12.0–14.0 sec Rapid punch-out/in bursts to whip distance back and forth at high speed. Even as the two shoulder-close, camera keeps in/out subdivisions every 16th note. Eye contact/fingertips to lens; zoom choppily tracks those fingertips. Soft smiles held with micro-vibration. ■14.0–15.0 sec (Final Killing Part) As the two step in and press close, max-speed snap zoom + whip stabs into a two-shot close-up. Even on arrival, not fully stopped—hold the decisive pose/smile/simultaneous wink with minimal amplitude, max-frequency micro-vibration. A finish that looks stopped but lives.

Midjourney + GPT Image 2 + Seedance 2.0

full body view of a female rabbit mechanoid --ar 2:3 --profile 8mk73g6 --sv 6 --stylize 1000 --preview

GPT Image 2 Prompt for Storyboard:
Create a balanced 16:9 landscape clean monochrome 2D storyboard line-sketch sheet for a rock-jumping pursuit; show four foot contacts, and do not render bracketed labels.

[HEADER]
Minimal header with crisp typography and one thin rule; show only:
"Hunt Through Ruin"
"Jump, fire, close the gap"

[BOARD]
Conventional balanced 16:9 storyboard contact sheet with 9 near-equal 16:9 landscape panels, clear gutters, natural P## reading order, and a centered incomplete last row when needed.
Headers use `P## / compact camera angle + shot size / short beat`, with no movement term; preserve count and order over packing.

[STYLE]
Clean monochrome 2D storyboard line sketch on white paper: sparse single-pass graphite-gray contours, simplified featureless pose figures, minimal construction marks, and only essential set geometry.
No fills, wash, hatching, shading, shadows, ambient occlusion, color, texture, 3D/clay volume, finished illustration, dense/repeated lines, or facial/anatomy/clothing/surface detail.

[REFERENCES]
Image A controls only Raby's gross build, long rabbit-helmet silhouette, armored limb volumes, and rifle outline as one bound identity package.

[CONTINUITY]
Raby keeps long ears, broad thigh armor, and the rifle right-handed; two-winged, six-limbed Razorwing stays ahead in the open down-right corridor.
Four rocks remain distinct; the P07 left-wing mark persists through P09.

[RULES]
Only the two header lines and panel headers are visible; no panel text, arrows, icons, insets, extra panels, duplicates, ghost poses, or object-like effect marks.

[BEATS]
Draw one storyboard panel per visual BEAT:
BEATS:
P01 / Ground front 3/4 FS / Hard Landing: Ground-height front three-quarter view pitched up, low horizon and first slab underside; Raby's left foot compresses the top at lower left, Razorwing ahead upper right.
P02 / Low rear 3/4 WS / First Launch: Knee-height rear three-quarter view pitched up with the split underside exposed; Raby extends down-right from the left-foot crater, fragments at that origin, Razorwing ahead.
P03 / High profile WS / Barrel Escape: Raised profile view pitched down over separated rock tops; Razorwing banks around a vertical shard at right, Raby stretched behind in the open corridor.
P04 / Ground profile FS / Second Landing: Ground-level profile with the second slab edge across foreground and narrow horizon; Raby's right foot compresses its top, Razorwing ahead right.
P05 / High OTS MLS / Swerve Fire: Raised left-shoulder view pitched down over twin rock tops; Raby aims the right-held rifle, one unfilled burst aligned with banked Razorwing between them.
P06 / Top-down WS / Third Contact: Overhead view with no horizon and isolated slab tops; Raby's left foot compresses a third slab upper left, Razorwing folded into a steep dive lower right.
P07 / Low front 3/4 MLS / Wing Graze: Rock-height front three-quarter view pitched up with undersides behind; airborne Raby aims right-held rifle, one unfilled burst linked to Razorwing's left-wing mark ahead.
P08 / Rear 3/4 WS / Spiral Plant: Chest-height rear three-quarter view pitched down over layered rocks; inverted Razorwing hugs a boulder's far curve, Raby's right foot planted on a fourth rock face behind.
P09 / High rear 3/4 WS / Falling Reach: Raised rear three-quarter view pitched down over descending rock tops; Raby extends from contact four, rifle right-held and left fingertips near marked Razorwing's tail down-right.

Seedance 2.0 Prompt:
Use @[storyboard ref] as ordered P01-P09 staging for one continuous shot without holds; written motion, references and global fields define final render.
Use @[character ref] only for C1 Raby's final identity and rifle.
C2 Razorwing is a slim six-limbed cobalt flyer with turquoise wings, violet tail tips, and yellow eyes, distinct from Raby.
One continuous 18mm developing master, no visible cuts.

SOUND: Electronic pulse; wind, servos, rock cracks, rifle blasts, creature shriek.

MOTION PHRASES:
P01-P09: Ground front 3/4 FS, lead with a brief rear handoff: C1 Raby lands left-foot first on the first falling slab, compresses, and bursts from its fracture, three foreshortened white shards whipping near-lens and past both edges as the camera races ahead-left to receive her leap; C2 Razorwing stays ahead in the open down-right route and snaps around a vertical shard in a barrel-roll, while Raby lands on one fixed left-foot point of the broad second slab, springs fully airborne, locks her right foot at a new point, and springs again before her body advances, the right-held rifle firing through Razorwing's knife-edge S-turn as a missed tracer chips one near-lens fragment clear of frame; the camera rises over her shoulder and curls ahead top-down as Raby touches the third slab at one fixed point and instantly spring-launches, a second red-orange burst grazing Razorwing's left wing with brief cyan sparks that never alter velocity; the mark persists as Razorwing whips into a tight corkscrew around a boulder, Raby taps the fourth vertical face at one fixed toe point and immediately leaves it while grit lashes past the lens edge, then the camera briefly hands rearward for her full-speed reach, rifle still right-held and left hand reaching for the forked tail as both plunge down-right.

0:00–0:01 — Already mid-stride. Dark Paris alley, camera bobbing with each heavy step, breath visible. Two Albanians ahead reach for weapons — gun arm raises — crack crack — both drop. Boots stepping over them, head checking doorways, keep moving.

0:03–0:05 — Alley opens into courtyard. Camera pauses one beat scanning. Two Albanians behind benches open fire — camera drops behind the dead tree, wood splintering right in front of us. Roll sideways — camera tumbling, sky and ground swapping — snap upright, gun raised — crack crack — both drop.

Knife swipes past the camera — lean back — hands grab his wrist — he wrenches free — swipes again — forearm blocks hard, camera shaking violently — drive forward, crash into the dirty wall together, plaster raining down. He headbutts toward the camera — head moves, his skull hits the wall — hands twist knife hand back sharply, knife drops — one precise strike to his throat — he slides down the wall in front of us. 这次不只是地面法阵
而是把整个蓄力空间立起来

符文展开、能量聚合、空间锁定

下一步，就是把它真正炸出去
蓄力只是前摇，真正的技能还没开始

Tracing，Lumen全局光照，Nanite高精度模型，PBR物理材质。CG国风暗黑仙侠动画，顶尖工作室渲染，8K超高清，HDR，ACES色彩管理，柯达5219胶片颗粒，电影级运镜，次表面散射，60fps高帧流畅无拖影无卡顿。宏大冰封神战遗迹，悬浮冰崖，巨大冰桥横跨深渊，清晨天光穿透寒雾在冰面折射神秘光晕。环境大气雾效，体积光穿透冰雾，低饱和莫兰迪国风色调+紫金雷光。轻微枕形畸变，紫边色散，发丝根根分明。 【全局·角色与特效】 主角（灵力化武·紫金剑客·东方术士）：暗黑国风破旧道袍，黑色乱发狂舞，眼神冷酷锐利。悬浮于画面右上角高空，单手伸出食指，指尖凝聚紫金雷光与金色符文。指尖前方，法阵斜向生成、斜向贯穿排列，像一条斜向切入画面深处的法阵长廊——法阵不是正面朝向镜头，而是斜着排列，从主角指尖斜向延伸至画面左下方深处，形成纵深透视的斜向法阵隧道。 每一层法阵由旋转圆环、八卦阵盘、太极阴阳鱼、天干地支符文、篆书咒印、五行光柱构成，层与层之间不断生成新的法阵，层层叠加、斜向贯穿，越往后越多，形成深邃的斜向立体法阵长廊。全身被紫金雷系粒子与暗红流体粒子全覆盖。 魔物（暗影魔物群）：成千上万只暗影魔物，由粘稠黑色流体构成，核心暗红闪烁。从地面、空中、裂缝疯狂涌来，铺天盖地，不断扑向天空中的主角，撞击法阵长廊外围，被雷光弹开、绞碎，但立刻补位。每镜必有剧烈反击。 特效厚度：流体60%（紫金雷系灵力+暗红流体）+粒子25%（金色星火+紫电粒子+金色符文碎粒）+水15%（寒雾/紫雾）。斜向法阵贯穿长廊特效覆盖大半个画面，最后发射时满屏吞噬。 【全局·核心规则与铁律】 60fps高帧。速度密度拉到极限：法阵生成与斜向贯穿排列速度25-35层/秒，魔物冲击不间断。0帧起手，开局即蓄力：第一帧远景直接呈现主角在右上角单手一指开始凝聚。全程零慢镜头：无任何顿帧/慢动作/定格/子弹时间。伪一镜到底不硬切，镜头从远景逐渐推近跟随斜向法阵贯穿长廊生成。景别EWS→FS→MS→MCU→CU逐级推进，最后发射FS满屏+尾帧。场景破坏永久保留。 镜头以远景EWS起手——主角悬浮于画面右上角高空，渺小身影被漫天魔物包围，单手伸出食指，指尖凝聚紫金雷光，法阵斜向生成、斜向贯穿排列，从指尖斜向延伸至画面左下方深处，像一条斜向切入画面纵深的法阵长廊；镜头逐步推近，WHIP甩镜跟随斜向法阵层层生成、斜向贯穿叠加、大小交替、纵深延伸，每一层法阵斜向旋转翻转、符文流转、五行光柱穿刺，魔物从四面八方疯狂扑击法阵长廊外围被雷光弹开绞碎；PUSH急推法阵核心，能量压缩至极限，TILT上摇跟随斜向法阵再次膨胀贯穿，FS满屏法阵发射紫金雷光吞没全画面，魔物全灭化为黑红/金白粒子消散，尾帧主角悬浮于清场余波中，地面永久裂痕——全程高速无顿帧、粒子全覆盖、魔物千万剧烈反击。 PUSH急推 镜头推进至CU特写，斜向法阵长廊极致压缩——层数极多、排列极密、斜向贯穿极深，形成一条由无数层法阵构成的斜向深邃隧道，从指尖斜向延伸至画面深处。
